title: TaskSprint
description: TaskSprint is a web application to manage your daily tasks. With it, you can create, filter, mark tasks as completed, and reorder tasks using drag & drop easily and quickly. Persistence is handled with LocalStorage, so your tasks remain between sessions.

title: WalletWise
description: Web application to manage financial transactions and categories, with features to create, edit, delete, and filter data. It also allows user profile management (change password and delete account). The interface is developed in React and the database uses MongoDB. Data visualization is done with Chart.js.

title: ChefNow
description: ChefNow is a web application that allows users to explore cooking recipes, create their own recipes, and view details of each one, both from a database and from the public TheMealDB API.

title: ReservEase
description: This project is a reservation system for spaces that allows users to register, log in, view available spaces, create and manage reservations, and for administrators to manage users, roles, spaces, and view all reservations. It includes JWT-based authentication, an interactive calendar, role management, and visual notifications to improve user experience.

title: iTunes
description: Mobile application created with React Native that allows searching for songs using the iTunes API, marking them as favorites, and sharing them on social networks.

title: WeatherOn
description: A simple mobile app to check daily weather forecasts, including maximum and minimum temperatures, humidity, and soon UV index.
tech: React Native, TypeScript, OpenWeatherMap API (One Call), Chart.js and LocalStorage
